name: Canadian Idol
description:
Canadian Idol was a Canadian reality television competition show which aired on CTV, based on the British show Pop Idol. The show was a competition to find the most talented young singer in Canada, and was hosted by Ben Mulroney. Jon Dore was the "roving reporter" for the first three seasons. Elena Juatco assumed the role for season four, Dave Kerr had the role in season five and Jully Black in season six.

The show began with a cross-Canada tour in which singers audition in front of four judges: Jake Gold of Toronto, Sass Jordan of Montreal, Quebec, Zack Werner of Winnipeg, Manitoba, and Farley Flex of Ajax, Ontario. Eventually the performers were narrowed down to 10 finalists, with each competitor performing live. Viewers had two hours following the broadcast of the show to phone in their votes for their favourite competitor. On the following night's episode, the competitor with the fewest votes was sent home. After the final two perform, viewers had more than two hours to vote. The next day, the competitor with the most votes was declared the winner. The show was taped at the John Bassett Theatre in Toronto, Ontario.

videos.title: The Best and the Worst of Canadian Idol
videos.overview:
Tue. Sept. 14 at 8pm ET - 10 New Idol Competitors Get Second Chance at Fame. They've watched from the sidelines as Jacob, Jason, Kalan, Shane and Theresa have become household names.

But now, 10 of the most ""unforgettable"" hopefuls from Canadian Idol's cross-country audition tour get a second chance at fame in The Best and the Worst of Canadian Idol, an all-new, one-hour special airing Tuesday, September 14 at 8 p.m. ET (check local listings) on CTV.

The 10 performers â€“ unsuccessful in their original quest for Idol-dom â€“ have been flown to Toronto from across the country to perform all-new numbers on the Canadian Idol stage. Producers have paired six of the 10 singers to perform three different duets: ""I Got You Babe,"" ""Almost Paradise,"" and ""Reunited."" The remaining three singers will unite together ""Three 10ors-style"" to perform one of the most-heard songs on the audition tour, ""A Whole New World.""

videos.title: Top 2 Performances
videos.overview:
Canadian Idol's final two contenders, Theresa Sokyrka and Kalan Porter, squared off Wednesday night in a highly-anticipated musical match to settle the ultimate question of who will be Canada's next singing sensation.

With three rounds of vocal sparring, Saskatoon's Sokyrka and Medicine Hat's Porter took turns showing off their performance skills under the watchful eye of the Idol judges and the viewing public who will vote for the final time to determine this year's Canadian Idol.

Performances:

Theresa Sokyrka-""Awake in a Dream"", ""Come Away With Me"", & ""Cruisin'""   Kalan Porter-""I Can Only Imagine"", ""Born to be Wild"", & ""Awake in a Dream""

videos.title: Season 2 Finale
videos.overview:
After months of auditions, miles of travel and millions of votes, Medicine Hat's Kalan Porter emerged triumphant as Canada's next Canadian Idol.

As revealed on Thursday night's live broadcast, the 18-year-old grabbed the most votes out of the 3.6 million cast after Wednesday's musical showdown in which he went head to head with Saskatoon's Theresa Sokyrka.

The shy singer with the booming set of pipes spoke with a shaky voice as he addressed the viewers after being proclaimed winner of the nationwide singing competition.

""I just want to say a big thank you to my parents and my family, the judges, everyoneâ€¦and thank you to these guys [Idols] who are back here,"" Porter said as Ben Mulroney removed confetti from the singer's hair.

Launching into his new role, Porter sang Awake in a Dream, his first single as a Canadian Idol that will immediately be put into rotation across radio stations Friday morning.

This is the kick off to the sixth season of Canadian Idol. For the first time in North America and only the second time in the world, Canadian Idol Online Auditions were held, casting the net even wider and resulting in an 11th virtual city stop.
